entries.finding: dispatch_consistency_passed bare bool bypass — AT-920 bypassable by any caller passing true without running validate_and_dispatch
entries.severity: P0 (escalated from P1 in Cycle 2 enriched review)
entries.rationale: Needs API reshape: replace bare bool with type-safe ValidatedDispatch proof token that can only be constructed by calling validate_and_dispatch. Zero production callers today — the bypass is theoretical until wired. Fix requires touching BaseGatesInput struct (5 touchpoints) and all test helpers.

entries.finding: AT-040 Err path structurally unreachable — all 74 ConfigParam variants have defaults so fail-closed branch has zero exercised coverage
entries.rationale: Academic finding — no ConfigParam without a default exists today. The fail-closed Err path would only fire if a param with no default and no env/config value is added. Revisit when a no-default param is introduced.

entries.finding: resolve_config_value conflates missing with unparseable — parse errors mapped to None silently apply defaults instead of failing closed
entries.rationale: Same root cause as DEBT-S1-010-01: all 74 params have defaults, so the distinction between Missing and ParseError is moot. When a no-default param is added, the resolver must distinguish these cases and return Err on parse failure.

entries.finding: position_reconcile_epsilon hardcoded to 1e-6 but contract requires max(1e-6, instrument min_amount)
entries.rationale: Needs contract clarification — CONTRACT.md specifies max(1e-6, min_amount) but it's unclear whether this means per-instrument epsilon or a global floor. For instruments with min_amount > 1e-6 (e.g., 0.001 BTC), the hardcoded 1e-6 is too tight and may cause persistent latch blocks. Requires spec discussion before code change.

entries.finding: Cycle 2 enriched review escalated dispatch_consistency_passed to P0 (Critical) — same root cause as DEBT-S1-007-01
entries.rationale: Duplicate root cause of DEBT-S1-007-01. Tracked separately because Cycle 2 independently escalated this from P1 to P0 based on enriched context (AT clause text + premortem §5 wrong-impl analysis). Resolution is the same: ValidatedDispatch proof token in Slice 2.
